verdict.rationale: Agent access to billing is a fair axis for an invoicing product. The evidence pack documents a programmatic surface only indirectly: the probes found no OpenAPI spec and a 404 on a markdown variant of an API introduction page. Credit notes, recurring invoices and stored-card charging are described only as app features, with no API or scoped-token documentation for agents to create subscriptions, apply credits or change plans.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate my billing — create a subscription, apply a credit, change a plan — through a programmatic surface with scoped permissions
